observations.subject: CPU model scope and documented Mmad processing direction
observations.detail: UnitFlag.md also describes processing-direction configuration when Fixpipe enables NZ2ND. The source does not explicitly call SetMMRowMajor; SDK/InitSocState defaults are outside the model. Existing gold requires recognizing the 2/3 UnitFlag protocol and does not certify complete SDK validity. An evidence-based limited reservation must not be equated with ignoring UnitFlag or asserting a measured bug. Apply this interpretation equally to every masked answer; do not add a post-hoc cap.
